title: [frontend] UI carga Excel Universo (upload → validate → preview diff → publish)
goal: Wire the Excel-upload wizard into the Universo tab (src/modules/pesaje/params/UniversoTab.tsx): subir .xlsx → POST .../universo/upload (validate) → render preview diff {added,removed,changed} or per-row/column errors (Publicar disabled if invalid) → POST .../universo/publish {upload_token} → refresh Universo card. Contract = JAA-580; mock-server is the seam.
contract_note: Real JAA-580 shapes (ms-process-api@8ecf8d2): upload -> {country, valid, errors:FieldError[], preview:{added:int,removed:int,changed:int}, upload_token:str|null}; publish body {upload_token} -> {country, table:'universo', unchanged:bool, row_count:int, version:WeightingParamsVersion{version:int,version_id,hash,published_by,published_at,diff}}. FieldError={row:int|null, field:str, message:str}. Invalid file=400 {error:'invalid_file'}; bad/consumed/cross-country token=404 {error:'not_found'}.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Uploading a valid xlsx shows the preview diff (added/removed/changed counts) before publish and enables Publicar.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest src/__tests__/UniversoUploadWizard.test.tsx (valid flow renders preview-added/removed/changed, universo-publish enabled); mock contract test ac1.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Uploading an invalid xlsx shows which row/column fails and leaves Publicar disabled.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest (invalid flow: errors panel shows 'fila N · field', universo-publish toBeDisabled); mock contract test: valid:false, errors[{row,field,message}], upload_token null.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Publishing with the upload_token persists and the Universo card reflects the new version.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: publishUniverso called with token; usePublishUniverso invalidates ['weighting-params','universo',pais]; mock publish bumps version + row_count; GET universo re-fetch reflects new row_count in the card badge.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: npm run build && npm run test green (API mocked) + lint + tsc.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm run test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b && npm run build all exit 0; mock contract suite green.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Publish-response shape matches the real JAA-580 contract (version is the nested WeightingParamsVersion object, not a flat number) so the mock seam does not diverge from ms-process-api.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: types.ts UniversoPublishResponse.version is WeightingParamsVersion; wizard toast reads data.version.version; mock publish returns nested version object; vitest + mock contract assert the nested shape.

Run VERIFY_CMD (vitest + lint + tsc + build + mock contract).
